Arabis-class sloop.question: The _____ was 1915 class of British minesweepers.
Arabis-class sloop.fact: The Arabis class was the third, and largest, of the five sub-classes of minesweeping sloops completed under the Emergency War Programme for the Royal Navy in World War I.
